historical_record.description: The Science Hall, men's and women's gymnasia and athletic field at San Francisco Junior College, now City College, 1940, by Timothy Pflueger.
City College was building its long-planned new library in the spring, the foundation dug and the steel frame going up; it was to be the largest building on the campus when finished in September 1995.

The Art Commission approved Milton T. Pflueger's addition to Smith Hall at City College, Project 902, after disapproving it twice in late 1962 for want of a landscape plan and for using too many materials.
The Art Commission approved the Phase 3 drawings for the Educational Services Building at City College, Project 202, by Milton T. Pflueger.
The Art Commission approved the Phase 3 drawings for the Laboratory and Classroom Building at City College, Project 201, by Milton T. Pflueger.
The Art Commission approved the Phase II plans for the Student Union Building at City College.

The Art Commission approved Frederick Olmsted's models for two sculptural pieces on the east facade of San Francisco Junior College, now City College, and Herman Volz's designs for mosaics in its north and south porticos (Resolution 352-1940-S).

The Art Commission approved the design and technique of Diego Rivera's fresco, from a photograph of the full-size drawing on the plaster, for installation in the library of San Francisco Junior College, but asked that the Board of Education, the project's sponsor, approve its subject first; the Board declined to act until the mural was finished.

The Art Commission tentatively approved Frederick Olmsted's drawings for murals in the entrance lobby of the Science building at San Francisco Junior College, which Timothy Pflueger had recommended to the Board of Education.

For the art programme of Cloud Hall East at City College, the Art Commission approved the sculptor Masatoyo Kishi and the landscape architects Royston, Hanamoto, Beck and Abey as participating artists, on the recommendation of the architect, John Pflueger of Milton Pflueger Associates.
The Art Commission approved the Phase III plans for the Social Science Classroom and Laboratory Building, Cloud Hall East, at City College.
The Art Commission approved Jacques Overhoff's sculpture for Cloud Hall East at City College, subject to the final colour of the concrete, after a commissioner raised its safety with the architects.
